description: Test suite for the configuration API in Mattermost, including tests for getting, updating, reloading, and permission-based access control of system configuration.

methods.name: TestGetConfig
methods.description: Tests retrieving configuration for system admin and local clients, including sanitization checks.

methods.name: TestGetConfigWithAccessTag
methods.description: Tests access control for configuration retrieval with specific permissions.

methods.name: TestGetConfigAnyFlagsAccess
methods.description: Tests configuration access with varying permissions.

methods.name: TestReloadConfig
methods.description: Tests reloading configuration as different user roles.

methods.name: TestUpdateConfig
methods.description: Tests updating configuration, permission checks, validation, sanitization, and protection of certain settings.

methods.name: TestUpdateConfigMessageExportSpecialHandling
methods.description: Tests special handling of message export timestamp when toggling enable/disable.

methods.name: TestUpdateConfigRestrictSystemAdmin
methods.description: Tests behavior when restrict system admin flag is enabled.

methods.name: TestUpdateConfigDiffInAuditRecord
methods.description: Verifies audit logs contain configuration diffs after updates.

methods.name: TestGetEnvironmentConfig
methods.description: Tests retrieval of environment variables configuration for different user roles.

methods.name: TestGetClientConfig
methods.description: Tests retrieval of client configuration with and without session, including backward compatibility.

methods.name: TestPatchConfig
methods.description: Extensive tests for patching configuration, including validation, permission checks, sanitization, and protection of certain settings.

methods.name: TestMigrateConfig
methods.description: Tests migration of configuration files from JSON to store.
